title: Sales agent: recommended lead and opportunity actions in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: Hold: the cost badge presents this change as metered even though its own licensing discussion correctly says that metering for this experience is unconfirmed. The roadmap facts and both cited administrative paths are supported; the statement that sellers receive no notice is not documented.
